source_text: The Kenyan (Kisumu) and Ugandan (Rakai) trials reported similar hazard ratios of 0.40 (95% CI: 0.24-0.68) and 0.49 (95% CI: 0.26-0.93), respectively, confirming consistent protective effects without evidence of delayed onset. [97]
